definitions.explanation: What is being talked about; the subject matter of a discussion or conversation.
Something that is currently being widely discussed or is popular.

examples.japanese: {話題|わだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えましょう→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.notes: 話題を変える = to change the topic

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧{話題|わだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is there any interesting topic to talk about?

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{話題|わだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}していて→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: She always has plenty of topics to talk about, so conversations with her are enjoyable.
examples.notes: 話題が豊富 = to have many things to talk about

examples.japanese: ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{話題|わだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦とも→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仲|なか}よく→仲良い：29434_nakayoi⟧⟦なりやすい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you share a common topic, it's easy to get along with someone you've just met.
examples.notes: 共通の話題 = a common topic of interest

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{話題|わだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The topic of the meeting shifted from next month's plan to budget issues.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話題|わだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This movie is a hot topic. / This movie is being talked about.
examples.notes: 話題になる = to become a topic of discussion

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{話題|わだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: That restaurant is the one everyone's talking about right now.

examples.japanese: {話題|わだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦みた→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I tried buying the much-talked-about new product, but it wasn't as good as I expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{話題|わだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: That news became a big talking point around the world.
examples.notes: 大きな話題になる = to become a big talking point

examples.japanese: ⟦SNS→SNS：05601_esuenuesu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{話題|わだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せたら→見せる：01988_miseru⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いていた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: When I showed my friends a video that went viral on social media, everyone was surprised.

notes:
USAGE: {話題|わだい} refers to conversation topics or things being discussed publicly.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {話題|わだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ (to change the subject)
- {話題|わだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a topic of discussion)
- {話題|わだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}する→提供：12909_teikyou⟧ (to provide a topic)
- {話題|わだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧/⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧ (a movie/book that everyone is talking about)
- ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{話題|わだい} (common topic of interest)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {話題|わだい} - topic of conversation
- ⟦{題名|だいめい}→題名：03421_daimei⟧ - title (of a work)
- ⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧ - theme, main subject

cross_references.note: title of a work (not a conversation topic)
